race.description: Team Edwards At Harcourts Country Boosted Hcp (Bm58)
race.comment: NUGGET SMART (3) is the one to beat after a sound BM66 effort at Muswellbrook and a Class 2 win at Tamworth the start prior, where he beat Hinto by a length and a half. He has won twice at this distance range and the return of Aaron Bullock, who has a win and a placing from three rides on him, strengthens the case. OUTOFTHEOFFICE (7) comes through Class 2 form at Taree, where he was well back before charging home into fifth, and the class relief gives him a genuine chance if he handles the step back to around 1450m better than his only prior attempt. AYE AYE SKIPPER (6) improved sharply when he gripped on late to secure third at Port Macquarie over 1500m. Proven in the conditions and gets map favours. CARMINE (4) resumed with an eye catching fifth in a Class 2 at Port Macquarie over 1200m after striking some interference. Extra trip in his favour and look for him late.
